title: Pressure and Containment
question: What happens when a face or figure seems to be held in—or bursting out of—its own boundaries?
introduction: Twenty works, each built around a head or skull, line these walls. In every one, outlines press inward while interior marks push back. Teeth, frames, bands, rings, and bolted visors recur as both structure and subject. The exhibition asks you to watch where the boundary holds, where it strains, and whether containment reads as protection or as trap.
closing: Each work draws its own edge and then tests it. Whether that edge reads as shelter or as cage may depend less on the marks than on the moment you look.

chapters.title: Faces That Float
chapters.introduction: Four heads presented against flat, unbroken grounds. The outline is the only thing separating figure from field—and it is already under pressure from within.

stops.whyHere: A translucent, layered head floats on an unbroken red field; overlapping color patches and mismatched yellow-pupiled eyes press against a soft outer edge.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #26

stops.whyHere: A heavy black outline holds a head crammed with multicolored scrawl against a clean blue ground; both eye sockets are filled with red-orange marks, and a red drop hangs from the chin.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both heads float on flat single-color grounds, but where the first outline is soft and translucent, this one is a thick black wall barely containing the wiring inside.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #32

stops.whyHere: On a saturated magenta field, loose gestural black marks trace a face with open, sparse lines—the ground itself does the pressing, leaving the marks little room to breathe.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The clean blue ground gives way to an all-over magenta that eliminates any sense of distance, pushing the face forward with nowhere to recede.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #44

stops.whyHere: A head emerges from a hot orange field as flat black fragments and wire-like outlines; a teal X in the eye area reads as something refused or sealed off.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The magenta field is replaced by a warm orange, but the same flatness persists—here the face fragments rather than consolidates, its eye crossed out rather than staring.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #43

chapters.title: Marks That Multiply
chapters.introduction: Works where the interior of the face is so densely layered that the marks themselves become a second kind of boundary—a cage built from scribble.

stops.whyHere: Yellow loops, teal tangles, and a jaw broken open by sharp white teeth build a head that vibrates against its still purple ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Moving from a fragmented orange face to a purple ground, the marks here multiply into a dense crown that feels like a shout caught mid-release.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #46

stops.whyHere: Dense interior hatching makes this animal-like head feel caged inside its own lines; teal peeks through gaps in the black scaffolding.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both works pile marks until the face feels trapped inside them, but where the previous erupts upward, this one turns inward, its whisker-lines pressing against the frame.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #56

stops.whyHere: Jagged white teeth appear everywhere—around eyes, across the brow, lining the mouth—so the whole head reads as a structure built from biting.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The animal silhouette gives way to a more frontal face, but the tooth motif spreads from mouth to every border, turning the whole surface into a biting edge.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #5

stops.whyHere: The face splits almost down its center—yellow and blue marks flood the left, red and teal claim the right—holding two distinct mark-fields in one skull.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous work repeats one motif across the whole face, this head divides itself, its dense marks segregated into two competing halves.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #53

stops.whyHere: Thick black scrawl surrounds a face whose two large eye sockets, each ringed with jagged crown-like spikes, stare out from an asymmetric, heavily worked skull.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The split face is replaced by one that feels compressed from all sides, its scrawl so dense the head seems to be shrinking under its own marks.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #54

chapters.title: Frames Within Faces
chapters.introduction: Works where a geometric structure—rectangle, grid, nested box, or band—appears inside or around the face, adding a second layer of enclosure.

stops.whyHere: A skull sits frontal on saturated blue; eye circles contain layered spirals and grids, and a dark grid of thin lines crosses the upper background.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The compressed, scrawled face opens onto a bright blue field, but the skull's eye sockets now contain their own internal grids—enclosure folded inside enclosure.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #59

stops.whyHere: A rectangular barred socket at the face's center suggests something sealed behind the surface; gold teeth flash against a dark mouth cavity like ornament and lock at once.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous work's grids sit inside the eyes, here a single barred rectangle dominates the face's center, reading unmistakably as a window with bars.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #50

stops.whyHere: Yellow banding runs across chin, cheeks, and forehead, striping the face like a crate; two eyes carry different internal marks—zigzag versus cross—lending asymmetric unease.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The barred socket gives way to horizontal banding that wraps the whole face, turning the head into a striped, boxed form.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #40

stops.whyHere: Teal bars stack along one edge while vertical stripes press the other; crossed-out eyes and a red triangle crown give the boxed-in head a confrontational charge.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both works use banding to press the face inward, but here the bands migrate to the margins, squeezing the head from outside rather than marking it from within.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #4

stops.whyHere: Concentric nested rectangles pull the eye toward a tight spiral at the center; sawtooth lines slice across the surface, with barely any negative space surviving—no face, only frame.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The banded face gives way to a composition where the frame is the entire subject—nested rectangles with no face at all, containment stripped to its purest geometry.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #1

stops.whyHere: Angular overlapping outlines lean and collide across the surface; a red-and-white spiral anchors the upper center while a zigzag band cuts the lower third, resisting any single focal point.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The concentric inward pull of the previous work is answered here by angular outlines that lean and collide, replacing centered compression with a restless, multi-directional push.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #2

chapters.title: Skulls, Ornaments, and the Enclosing Ring
chapters.introduction: Skull forms carrying added weight—chains, visors, medallions, a white ring—where the ornament both adorns and further constrains the form, and the boundary becomes a visible object in its own right.

stops.whyHere: Red dashes burst outward behind the skull like a broadcast signal; teeth ring the eye sockets as well as the jaw, multiplying mouths across the whole face.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Moving from abstract boxes back to a face, this skull radiates outward—the first work in the exhibition where the boundary seems to be pushing energy away rather than holding it in.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #25

stops.whyHere: A chain and medallion pull the skull rightward; radiating color bands fan behind it, making the form feel ornamental and hollow at once.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous skull broadcasts outward through red dashes, this one is weighted down by a chain, its outward radiation replaced by decorative gravity.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #24

stops.whyHere: Rectangular goggle-like eye shapes give the skull a mask quality; cyan and yellow patches leak through black scaffolding, giving the form an unstable, lit-from-within appearance.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The chain of the previous work adds external weight; here the skull's own eye sockets become rigid rectangular frames, containment built into the anatomy itself.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #48

stops.whyHere: An oversized pink visor turns eyewear into a grinning mouth-border; a small dripping form at the jaw suggests something leaking out of an otherwise sealed figure.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous skull's rectangular eyes are hollow and stiff, this visor is pink and tooth-rimmed, transforming a protective object into a boundary that grins back.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #16

stops.whyHere: A heavy white ring frames a face staring through mismatched eyes—one ringed in yellow-green spikes, the other a tight spiral; all pattern density is concentrated inside the circle, the surrounding field left sparse.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The visor of the previous work is a partial frame; here a complete white ring encloses the entire face, making the boundary a deliberate, visible object and closing the exhibition's central question in plain sight.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #31

title: Body in the Field
question: How does a figure change when we can see its whole body, its setting, or other figures beside it?
introduction: These twenty works follow figures from solitary, full-body stances through crowded groupings and into open landscapes. Along the way, bodies press against their backgrounds, stack on top of one another, dissolve into color fields, or vanish into silhouette. Each shift asks what a figure carries—and what it loses—when the world around it grows larger or more insistent.
closing: By the final works, the figure has nearly surrendered to its surroundings. Whether that surrender reads as release or erasure depends on what you noticed along the way.

chapters.title: Stance and Static
chapters.introduction: Four figures stand or crouch alone, each pressing outward against a charged background. The body is the whole subject here—posture, outline, and the noise that surrounds it.

stops.whyHere: A wide-legged, fist-raised figure fills the frame; its golden body and radiating bone shapes establish the exhibition's opening note of physical assertion.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #57

stops.whyHere: Arms lift again, but the patchwork torso begins to dissolve into the background, softening the clear outline of the previous figure.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the first figure held a crisp white edge, this figure's contours loop and blur, the body already merging with its ground.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #10

stops.whyHere: The seated, hunched posture reverses the upward energy; compressed limbs and close-set eyes shift the mood from assertion to withdrawal.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The raised arms of the previous work drop entirely; the figure folds inward, its bright blue shirt the only outward push against a heavy grey field.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #9

stops.whyHere: A standing figure in a grid-patterned garment holds still against a warm, quiet background; two small blue eye-marks stare out from layered color fields.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The seated slump straightens into a guarded upright stillness, but the face remains unresolved—competing color patches replacing tangled contour lines.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #8

chapters.title: Head as Event
chapters.introduction: These works shift weight dramatically upward. Oversized heads, bolted visors, dotted wraps, and crossed-out eyes make the skull itself the site of the most visible action.

stops.whyHere: An enormous glowing head on a frail scratched body; translucent washes and a red-circle crown make the head the composition's entire event.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The grid-garmented figure's restrained face gives way to a head so large it nearly erases the body beneath it.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #27

stops.whyHere: A bolted visor clamps over a skull packed with yellow-lavender hatching; the tiny stick body below makes the head's overflow feel precarious and exposed.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both works feature oversized heads on diminished bodies, but here the skull is clamped and frantic where the previous head glowed with translucent calm.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #7

stops.whyHere: A dotted blue wrap presses the head downward; one eye peers through tangled lines, and white streaks at the left edge suggest separation from open space.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The bolted visor of the previous work is replaced by soft fabric weight; containment shifts from mechanical to draped, yet the face remains equally obscured.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #11

stops.whyHere: Crossed-out eyes seal the face shut; the warm yellow field presses close with rounded cellular shapes, trapping the dark head inside a living surface.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The dotted wrap gave one eye a gap to peer through; here both eyes are crossed out, the face fully closed to the viewer.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #13

stops.whyHere: The face dissolves almost entirely into the golden ground; two pale-blue crosses and a small red mark are the only features left in the warm field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The sealed eyes of the previous work become near-total dissolution here—the face present only as a gap between tangled dark lines and warm color.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #51

chapters.title: Figures Together
chapters.introduction: Solitude ends. Bodies stack, crowd, and jostle. The question shifts from what a single figure carries to what changes when figures share the frame.

stops.whyHere: A lone formal figure stands before an oversized shadow hand; the looming second presence introduces the idea of another body without showing one directly.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The dissolved face of the previous work is replaced by a clean white circle; but a giant shadow hand behind the figure inserts an unseen companion.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #36

stops.whyHere: A broad figure carries a smaller one on its back, linked by tendrils; stacking makes the relationship between bodies the composition's central question.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The shadow hand hinted at a second presence; here that second figure is fully visible, perched on top and physically connected.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #37

stops.whyHere: Three spiky figures sit on a shared platform against a looping maze; distinct facial marks on each suggest separate moods held in uneasy proximity.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The stacked pair becomes a seated trio; the vertical relationship flattens into a horizontal row, and the maze background boxes them in together.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #34

stops.whyHere: A single standing figure returns, but its spiked crown, bared teeth, and layered outlines make it feel like a confrontation directed outward at the viewer.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The seated trio's shared tension is concentrated into one standing figure; its wide stance and radiating spikes address the space in front of it rather than beside it.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #62

stops.whyHere: Speech-bubble punctuation and a frowning sun introduce off-frame presences; the spread-armed figure is caught between signals from multiple unseen sources.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous figure's confrontation was physical; here it becomes textual—question marks and exclamation points crowd the margins as though others are responding.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #41

stops.whyHere: Animal-like black forms tangle across a pink field; overlapping figures and looping lines make individual bodies nearly impossible to separate from one another.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The speech-bubble scene kept figures legibly apart; here outlines merge and crowd until the boundary between one body and the next dissolves entirely.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #33

stops.whyHere: A tall central figure anchors a field of competing heads, teeth, and smaller forms; black divisions cut through saturated color, resisting any single reading.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The tangled forms of the previous work gain a structural framework here—black divisions impose order, yet the crowded field still refuses to settle.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #0000

chapters.title: Body as Line and Knot
chapters.introduction: Two works strip the figure back to its most basic mark: a coiling line and a sealed silhouette. Setting recedes; what remains is the shape of a body against a flat or patterned ground.

stops.whyHere: A thick black line doubles back on itself into a body-shaped knot; the red-X face at the end of the winding path gives the tangle a dazed identity.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The crowded multi-figure field compresses into a single coiling form; all the surrounding noise becomes one restless, self-entangled shape.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #35

stops.whyHere: A black silhouette curves inward against olive and yellow-green fields; a white eye and white arm-shape are the only interruptions in an otherwise sealed form.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The knotted line-body of the previous work resolves into a clean silhouette; detail disappears, leaving only the curve of a bent posture and two white breaks.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #39

chapters.title: Into the Field
chapters.introduction: The final works move the figure into landscape or dissolve it into open space. Setting is no longer background—it becomes the subject, and the body must negotiate its place within it.

stops.whyHere: Upright dark forms and pale clustered marks suggest a wooded opening; long forms entering from below give the eye directions to follow without a clear figure to anchor them.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The sealed silhouette of the previous work stood against a flat olive-yellow ground; here the ground itself becomes complex, and figure-like forms are absorbed into it.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #65

stops.whyHere: Slender dark verticals beneath a large yellow circle suggest trees and sky; horizontal lines in the foreground provide a different, flatter rhythm that opens the composition outward.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both works suggest landscape through vertical and horizontal marks, but this one introduces a broad radiating circle that pushes the scene toward expansiveness rather than enclosure.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #64

evidence.limitation: Ensemble sheet review and three original anchors; not full-resolution individual inspection of every work or a visitor study

title: Face as Frequency
question: When a face is built from competing marks, colors, and symbols, what—if anything—does it still communicate?
introduction: Every work here is, technically, a face. But each one is also a collision: of color temperatures, mark systems, eye shapes, tooth rows, and grounds that refuse to stay back. This exhibition moves from faces organized around a single dominant feature, into heads where every element broadcasts at once, and finally to figures where the face begins to dissolve into its own noise.
closing: Twenty-six faces, each assembled from marks that pull in different directions. Whether anything coherent survives that competition is a question each work leaves open.

chapters.title: One Thing in Charge
chapters.introduction: These faces organize themselves around a single dominant element—an oversized head, a sealed gaze, a split down the middle—that holds the composition together even as smaller marks scatter around it.

stops.whyHere: The vast golden head crowds out everything else; a lavender mask covers both eyes and scattered triangles orbit the form without challenging its dominance.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #3

stops.whyHere: A clean vertical split divides warm pale yellow from darker brown, replacing W003's radiant mass with a face organized by a single color boundary.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where W003 is unified by warm yellow volume, W008 fractures along one chromatic line, making division the organizing principle.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #63

stops.whyHere: Rectangular glasses seal the eyes entirely; the single vivid red-orange lip becomes the only open channel in an otherwise blocked face against a flat olive ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W008's split is chromatic; W015's blockage is architectural—dark frames physically close off the upper face, redirecting attention to the single bright lip below.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #14

stops.whyHere: Wide blue-framed sunglasses with mirrored yellow reflections seal the eyes; a prominent pink-outlined mouth, scribbled yellow hair, and scattered dots pile ornament onto opacity against unbroken red.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both W015 and W065 use opaque eyewear to withhold expression; W065 adds a clown-like mouth and festive surface marks that make the concealment feel louder rather than guarded.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #28

chapters.title: The Mouth Takes Over
chapters.introduction: Here the mouth—teeth, jaw, open gap—moves from supporting feature to compositional engine, pulling the eye downward and forward with blunt force.

stops.whyHere: A rigid white tooth grid and tilted sunglasses split the face into sealed top and shouting bottom, with warm orange rays fanning outward behind the head.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W065's sealed eyes reappear here, but a wide tooth grid below them shifts the balance from concealment toward confrontation.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #6

stops.whyHere: A wide-open mouth with a dark central gap dominates the lower half; scattered red hearts above read as frantic against the teal ground rather than tender.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W033's teeth are bared but contained within a closed grid; W050's mouth opens into a dark cavity, adding urgency to what was already a shout.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #49

stops.whyHere: Heavy black flat shapes build a skull-like mass; red-hatched eye sockets and bared white teeth push toward confrontation, softened by loose pink and purple loops drifting past the jaw.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W050's mouth commands a bright, busy surface; W021 buries its teeth in a dark form against a dark green ground, making the grin feel heavier and more ambiguous.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #45

stops.whyHere: Two tooth-bearing forms share the frame—a large head with a pale horizontal tooth row and a smaller yellow head with sharp triangular teeth—with magenta rings drawing unequal attention to each.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W021 has one face with one mouth; W036 doubles the tooth motif across two unequal heads, turning the jaw into a repeated, almost absurd refrain.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #61

stops.whyHere: Dense black lines pool at the base around a downturned mouth on a flat orange field; the small white teeth are part of a larger tangle of marks that press inward from every side.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W036's two mouths feel confrontational and outward-facing; W005 compresses the same energy into a single crouched figure, the teeth almost buried under surrounding marks.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #47

chapters.title: Eyes That Broadcast
chapters.introduction: These works shift emphasis upward: eyes become targets, spirals, mismatched lenses, or single overwhelming orbs—each a different kind of signal competing with the face around it.

stops.whyHere: A single red-iris eye dominates the composition; teal vertical bars and a blue crosshatched grid below it read as a cage sealing the lower face, leaving the small mouth at the far edge.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W005's eyes stare outward from a dense tangle of marks; W007 isolates one eye as the entire subject, surrounding it with containment structures rather than open ground.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #19

stops.whyHere: One oversized eye ringed by tooth-like zigzags and yellow spikes stares from a swirling maroon cavity; a small red lip on a stem and a green clover shape at lower left offer a quiet counterpoint.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W007's eye is framed by geometric bars and a grid; W028's eye is framed by organic spikes and teal dripping marks, making the stare feel more visceral and less architectural.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #20

stops.whyHere: Two spiral clusters of different hues form asymmetric eye-like zones on a saturated pink ground; a toothy horizontal bar anchors the lower half while white scribbles blur every boundary.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W028 has one dominant eye at the center of the composition; W052 distributes the eye-function across two competing spirals, making the gaze plural and off-balance.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #29

stops.whyHere: Mismatched eyes topped by green hearts stare from a dense field of cyan arcs and yellow bands; the broad toothy mouth refuses to let the eyes hold focus alone.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W052's spirals function as the whole face; W009 restores a full face but packs every element—eyes, mouth, background—at equal volume so nothing can dominate.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #58

stops.whyHere: Target-like concentric eyes are the most controlled marks in an otherwise restless surface of scribble tangles and flat dark planes, lending the figure a watchful stillness against the flat cobalt ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W009's eyes compete with everything around them at equal volume; W023's eyes are the calmest element, creating tension by contrast with the frantic marks surrounding them.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #23

stops.whyHere: Two visibly unequal eyes—a dark outlined oval on the left and a gold-ringed stare on the right—pull attention across a tilted face; heavy outlines hold the form while thinner colored lines wander past its edges.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W023's eyes are symmetrically concentric and similarly built; W056's eyes differ in shape, color, and size, making the asymmetry itself the visible subject.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #55

chapters.title: Faces Under Pressure
chapters.introduction: These works pack the face—or the space around it—so densely with competing marks, symbols, and color zones that the face itself becomes one element among many rather than the organizing center.

stops.whyHere: A rounded outline crammed with a crown, a spoked wheel, dotted borders, and a red zigzag jaw reads as a face and a packed container simultaneously, the interior competing with the boundary.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W056's face is held together by heavy outlines against a relatively open ground; W037's outline contains so much competing content that the face-reading becomes unstable.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #30

stops.whyHere: Four overlapping head-forms crowd the frame, each staked out by a different color zone, stitched together by a repeated jaw-and-tooth motif that runs across all of them.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W037 packs one face-container past capacity; W011 multiplies the containers, so the question of which face to read becomes unanswerable.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #60

stops.whyHere: A head locked in scaffolding of heavy black and red framing lines sits against a yellow ground crowded with gray block-letter shapes, blurring the boundary between figure and annotation.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W011's faces compete with each other; W019's single face competes with text-like shapes in its ground, shifting the pressure from internal crowding to external interference.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #42

stops.whyHere: Against saturated red, overlapping loops of black, sky blue, and white compete for space; small heart-like shapes and a lavender spot at the base are easy to miss beneath the surrounding commotion.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W019's ground presses in with letter-shapes while the figure remains readable; W026's figure and ground merge into a single knotted density, making the face-reading uncertain.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #38

stops.whyHere: The figure emerges from total black as a tangle of warm color patches and wire-like cyan lines; two red-rimmed eyes hold their position as the only stable point in the composition.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W026 dissolves into its saturated red ground; W049 dissolves into black, but two red-rimmed eyes remain fixed, offering the only clear anchor in the composition.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #52

chapters.title: Signal and Residue
chapters.introduction: The final group: faces that have absorbed their own noise and arrived somewhere quieter—not resolved, but settled into a particular register of mark, color, and posture.

stops.whyHere: Pale multicolored rays push outward from behind the head; warm tones pool on one side, cool blue on the other, splitting the face into contrasting temperatures without breaking its outline.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W049 emerges from darkness with marks pressing inward; W022 radiates outward into a light ground, reversing the direction of pressure while keeping the face's expression mid-shift.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #15

stops.whyHere: Diagonal rays fan outward from the lower face area; thick color patches build mass while thin neon scribbles hover above like static against the flat cobalt-blue ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W022's rays emanate from behind the head; W024's rays push from the jaw area itself, making the radiation feel like something the face is producing rather than receiving.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #22

stops.whyHere: Every surface carries a different fill—scribbled hat crown, rainbow bands across the face, diagonal hatching on the brim—locked into compartments by heavy black outlines against a bubbly pastel ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W024's marks feel like escaping energy pushing outward; W040's marks are contained within rigid outlines, turning the same density into something more structured and sealed.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #18

stops.whyHere: A white polka-dot field pushes the figure forward like a cut-out; dark-lensed sunglasses hide expression, leaving the cigarette and cap tilt to carry the attitude.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W040's face is packed with competing fills held by heavy outlines; W045 simplifies to a flat patterned ground and a single withheld expression, making restraint feel like its own kind of noise.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #17

stops.whyHere: Flat blue ground, tangled scribble lines holding soft color patches together, open mouth and mismatched eyes—a face assembled from interference, its shout suspended rather than released.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W045 withholds expression behind sunglasses and a flat ground; W046 opens the mouth wide, but the surrounding scribble and flat blue field make the shout feel caught rather than completed.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #21

stops.whyHere: A profile tilting into the frame, built from overlapping color patches that never solidify; a single red streak cuts across the face and vertical stripes drape from the jaw into the purple ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W046 faces forward with a frozen open mouth; W063 turns away in profile, its marks dissolving into the purple ground, leaving expression as a residue rather than a statement.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #12
